name: Phantom
source:
A mysterious young man who ocassionally appear to Nozomi. A fleeting being who is hard to tell if he is real or illusion. He talked to Nozomi like he know everything and giving her a shards that opened the door to the mysterious labyrinth.

[Spoiler]He is Taira no Kiyomori who was eaten by Dakiniten during the peace treaty between Genji and Heike. His appearance here is older than the one in the prequel[/Spoiler]
